## Overview

Headless tooltip directive. Attach to any element to show a tooltip on hover/focus.

Usage with string:
```html
<button qzTooltip="Save changes" tooltipPlacement="bottom">Save</button>
```

Usage with template:
```html
<button [qzTooltip]="richTpl" tooltipPlacement="right">Info</button>
<ng-template #richTpl>
  <div class="my-tooltip"><strong>Rich</strong> content</div>
</ng-template>
```

- **Kind:** Directive
- **Export as:** `qzTooltip`
- **Source:** [packages/primitives/src/tooltip/tooltip.directive.ts:55](https://github.com/Andersseen/quartz/blob/main/packages/primitives/src/tooltip/tooltip.directive.ts#L55)
